name: Gmail
description: Connect Gmail independently to search, read, and organize email or create drafts and send messages. Only Gmail permissions are requested; authorization and tokens are managed by the host.
whenToUse: Use this plugin to search Gmail, read message bodies, organize labels, create drafts, or send email. Connect a Gmail account separately in this plugin's details first.

gmail_accounts.description: List the Gmail accounts connected to this plugin and their status. Accounts must be authorized separately in the Gmail plugin details.

gmail.description: Run a Gmail operation: search messages, read message bodies, send email, save a draft, modify labels, or list labels. Sending and organizing actions require clear user intent.
